directives.title: Saber gets a stamina resource (melee identity)
directives.acceptance: Saber cannot swing when stamina below cost; whiff still costs stamina; stamina regens while not swinging; cooldown/recovery remains.

directives.title: Land the soak->bubble rule in match.js (shared rules, not client-only)
directives.acceptance: Soak field on players in MatchSim; soak drains on movement, holds on stillness; soaked->bubble terminal state for fixed duration; one terminal state at a time (bubble or HP-down, not both); offline and online run the same soak logic.

directives.title: README status table reflects both weapon families
directives.acceptance: README lists Tactical FPS (hitscan carbine), Splat Brawl (projectiles, soak->bubble), and Melee Saber (stamina-gated swings) as distinct first-class combat systems; README no longer says PvP is only hitscan gunplay.

challenge_for_mikel: Saber combat needs a resource — stamina or heat? And does the saber parry or not? Pick stamina over heat. Commit to the saber being a pacing/footwork weapon, not a damage-spike weapon. Drop the parry for now. Then the saber's identity is: you have 2-3 swings, you commit to each one, you recover and move. That's a melee fantasy. The projectile user's identity is: I'm loading 2-3 shots, predicting where you'll be, watching the arc. Both read clearly, both have a resource, both coexist.
